en: A black-and-white vintage postcard depicting an outdoor spa or bath square. The foreground features cafe tables with cloths and wrought-iron chairs, while farther back is a well-maintained garden with benches. In the background, there is a grand building with classical columns, surrounded by manicured topiary and large trees. The text 'Bad Elster - Badeplatz' is printed in the bottom right corner.
